name: Yuri Lindberry
source:
Star Sign: Leo
Elemental Attribute: Fire
Special Attribute: Charm 4
Starting Spells: Fire 4/Lightning 5/Quake 4/Ice 3/Healing 3/Shield 3
Symbol: A wand with the Lindberry coat of arms on it (Level 4)

A superman whose family, looks, smarts, and personality are all perfect.
He's Akito's rival and roommate.
He's engaged to Charlotte by both of their parent's decisions.
